name: scan_repository
title: Scan repository
description: Call when you are about to plan work on a repository and need its lifecycle findings first: deprecated packages, end-of-life runtimes, retired APIs, at exact file and line. Runs every built-in Offing detector locally, with no network. Returns offing.scan.v1. On a large repository the answer is cut; list_deprecations lists the findings more compactly.

repository_path.description: Local path to the repository. Defaults to the server working directory.

baseline.description: Optional path, relative to the repository, of an Offing baseline file. Suppressed findings are left out and the result's suppressions field says how many, and which suppressions are expiring or expired.

data.description: Which lifecycle data this result was produced with, and how fresh its evidence is.

stale.description: True when the data is older than 30 days.

identity.description: Optional producer identity in a scan. A Git HEAD does not certify a clean checkout.

advisoryIds.description: OSV advisory identifiers with no fixed version for this finding's package, from the bundled OSV cross-reference.

asOf.description: The day the scan was projected onto with --as-of. Present only when one was given.

selection.description: The --only/--exclude selectors applied to the scan. Present only when one was given.

only.description: Ecosystem ids or rule-id prefixes the scan kept.

exclude.description: Ecosystem ids or rule-id prefixes the scan dropped.

coverage.description: What the scan checked, so a zero-finding report can say what was covered and what was not. Path arrays are complete here; the text report may show only the first ten of each.

ecosystems.description: Detector ids that matched at least one input file in the repository, sorted.

filesRead.description: Repository-relative paths matched by detector inputs, sorted. Complete list; the text report may truncate display.

unsupportedFiles.description: Paths of unclassified pins or other unsupported declarations, sorted. Complete list; the text report may truncate display.

truncated.description: True when the coverage walk stopped early at its entry limit, so ecosystems may be incomplete.

suppressions.description: What a baseline did to this scan. Present only when a baseline was applied.

today.description: The day suppression dates were compared with, when one was given.

expiring.description: Suppressions in force that end within the warning window, soonest first.

expired.description: Suppressions that have ended and no longer hide their finding, longest ago first.

truncated.description: Always true: the answer was cut to fit the size cap.

hint.description: How to read what was left out.

omitted.description: One entry per array that lost elements. A path with [] sums every array at that position, including those inside elements that were left out.

path.description: Where the array sits, such as findings or findings[].usages.

shown.description: Elements in the answer as returned.

clipped.description: Path of every text that was shortened; it ends with a truncation marker.

estimatedTokens.description: Size of the answer as returned: three characters of JSON text count as one token.

policy.description: Evaluation of explicit lifecycle policy rules after scan filters.

Re-scans the repository locally, with no network, and checks the finding observed earlier in this session. Returns offing.verification.v1 with verified, the findings a fresh scan still reports, and suggested commands, which are never run.

name: check_dependency
title: Check dependency
description: Call before you install, add, or pick a package or GitHub Action. Pass a Package URL such as pkg:npm/request@2.88.2 or pkg:github/actions/checkout@v4. Returns offing.check.v1 with replacement first when one is known, then status: affected, version-dependent, not-affected, or no-data. no-data means Offing has no rule for the package, not that it is safe. Reads no repository and no network.

purl.description: Package URL of the dependency, with the version when it is known, for example pkg:npm/request@2.88.2.

version.description: Exact version to check; overrides a version written in the PURL.

outputSchema.title: Offing dependency check v1
outputSchema.description: The result of checking one package, and optionally one version, against Offing's lifecycle rules. In an MCP answer the replacement, when one is known, is the first field and the status the second.

replacement.description: The replacement named by the most severe finding. It comes first in an answer so it is read before the status; it is absent when no finding names one.

data.description: Which lifecycle data this result was produced with, and how fresh its evidence is.

stale.description: True when the data is older than 30 days.

status.description: no-data means Offing has no rule for the package; it does not mean the package is safe.

name: check_upgrade
title: Check upgrade
description: Call before you upgrade to a runtime, such as php@8.4 or nodejs@22. Reads the lockfiles and manifests in the repository; runs nothing, uses no network. Returns offing.upgrade.v1: the verdict and every blocker, warning, and unknown with its path, line, and constraint. An unknown verdict means no evidence was found; it is not a statement that the upgrade is safe.

path.description: Local path to the repository. Defaults to the server working directory.

target.description: Runtime and release to move to, as runtime@version, for example php@8.4 or nodejs@22.

outputSchema.title: Offing upgrade report v1
outputSchema.description: Whether a repository can move to a target runtime, answered from files already in the repository.

verdict.description: blocked when any blocker; unknown when no analyzer applied; ready otherwise. unknown is not a statement that the upgrade is safe.

analyzers.description: Ids of the analyzers that applied to this repository and target, sorted.

level.description: blocker: will not install or run on the target. warning: works but is deprecated there. unknown: the evidence needed is missing.

value.description: The exact value as written in the file, or a lifecycle rule id.

graph.description: Confirmed blockers grouped by the shortest recorded path. Blockers without a recorded path remain ungrouped.

name: forecast_repository
title: Forecast repository
description: Call when you plan a roadmap or upgrade schedule and need to know what reaches end of life first. Runs a fresh local scan, with no network. Returns ebb.forecast.v1: buckets by months left (0-3, 3-6, 6-12) with the events that affect this repository, then the same events by month. Only dated events are listed; nothing is estimated.

repository_path.description: Local path to the repository. Defaults to the server working directory.

months.description: How many months ahead to look, from 1 to 36. Defaults to 12.

as_of.description: The day to start the window from, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in UTC.

buckets.description: Events grouped by how many months away they are: 0-3, 3-6, and 6-12, then on to the horizon. Every event is in exactly one bucket, by its date. `events` lists only the events that affect this repository, so it has `affecting` elements; `total` counts every event in the bucket.

from.description: Months after the window starts where the bucket begins.

to.description: Months after the window starts where the bucket ends.

until.description: The last day in the bucket.

label.description: The horizon as the terminal report prints it.

affecting.description: How many of them affect at least one finding in the repository.

noData.description: Components without local lifecycle coverage. Current producers always include this array.
